hint.level_0: Calculate the base fare, then the metered fare, then add the surcharge.

questions.stem: A pyramid of cubes is built in layers. Layer 1 (top) has 1 × 1 = 1 cube. Layer 2 has 2 × 2 = 4 cubes. Layer 3 has 3 × 3 = 9 cubes. Each cube has side 3 cm. What is the total volume of a 5-layer pyramid?
questions.visual_context: Pyramid built with layers of cubes: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25 cubes from top to bottom.

hint.level_0: Total cubes = 1² + 2² + 3² + 4² + 5².
hint.level_2: Volume per cube = 3³ = 27 cm³. Total = 55 × 27 = 1,485 cm³.

questions.stem: Cubes of side 1 cm are used to build hollow cubes (only the outer shell, no cubes inside). A hollow cube of side 3 uses 26 cubes (27 − 1 inside). A hollow cube of side 4 uses 56 cubes (64 − 8 inside). How many cubes does a hollow cube of side 6 use?
questions.visual_context: Hollow cube showing only the outer shell of unit cubes.

hint.level_0: Hollow cube cubes = total cubes − inside cubes.
hint.level_1: Total = 6³ = 216. Inside cube has side 6 − 2 = 4, so inside = 4³ = 64.
